blocks.title: Page 1
blocks.text:
GLEUHR WELLNESS PVT LTD
Cross-Sell & Upsell Playbook
For counsellors · service upsell, the right way · understand need → time it → sync with doctor
The Philosophy — read this first
Cross-sell is care, not pressure. You only ever pitch a treatment the client genuinely needs, at the moment she is 
happiest with her results. Done right, she feels seen and looked after. Done wrong, she feels sold to — and never 
trusts you again.
The four rules that make it work
• 1. Understand the need first. Never pitch blindly. Look at her, her concern, her result so far — then offer 
what truly fits. The need must be real.
• 2. Time it to satisfaction. The best moment is when she is glowing and happy with a result. A satisfied client 
is open; an unsatisfied one is not. Pitch on the high, never the low.
• 3. Sync with the doctor. For medical treatments (fillers, Botox, advanced under-eye), the doctor leads. Set it 
up, then let the doctor confirm clinically. Never promise what only the doctor should decide.
• 4. Build the relationship — don’t only call for balances. If the client feels you only call when money is due, 
your cross-sell rate is near zero. Stay in touch with care — check on her, her results, her family — so when 
you do suggest something, she trusts it’s for her.
Products vs service: products upsell easily because they’re her ongoing need — that takes care of itself. This 
playbook is about service upsell, which needs timing, trust, and the doctor’s lead. That’s the skill.
The Move — every cross-sell follows this shape
1) Praise the result she already has (“aap glow kar rahi ho”). 2) Name the next need gently (the hollowness, the 
fine lines, the dark circles). 3) Offer the fix simply. 4) No pressure — “ghar ja ke soch lena, next time karwa 
dungi.” 5) Lock the next step — best deal, note it on her card. 6) If the doctor is available, offer same-day.
The Scripts
Use these as your base — improvise to fit the client and make her feel empowered, never pressured. The doctor leads on fillers, Botox 
and advanced under-eye.
1 · Fillers (doctor-led)
“Maam aap glow kar rahi ho pigmentation treatment ke baad — result bahut acche hain aap ke. 
Maam under-eyes mein thodi hollowness hai, yeh bhi cover ho jaayegi — fillers karwa lenge, iske liye 
bas 2ml tak filler lagega.
Aap ghar ja ke soch lena, fir jab next time aaoge tab karwa dungi — aur best deal bhi de dungi. Maam 
card pe details mention kar deti hoon.”
Coaching: Pitch on the glow. Keep the volume (“2ml tak”) light and let the doctor confirm the exact amount — 
you set it up, the doctor leads. “Ghar ja ke soch lena” removes pressure and builds trust.
2 · Wrinkles / Botox (doctor-led)
“Maam aap glow kar rahi ho pigmentation treatment ke baad — result bahut acche hain. Maam yeh 
jo fine lines ya wrinkles hain face pe, yeh bhi theek ho jaayenge — Botox ho jayega aur face bilkul 
young lagega.
Aap ghar ja ke soch lena, fir next time aaoge tab karwa dungi — best deal bhi de dungi. Card pe 
details mention kar deti hoon.”
Agar doctor available ho: “Maam one-day session hai, aaj bhi ho jayega — baaki jaise aap kaho, aur 
main aap ko best deal de dungi.”

Coaching: “Face young lagega” sells the feeling, not the procedure. If the doctor is free, the same-day line 
converts on the spot — but only with the doctor’s clinical go-ahead.
3 · Body Polishing & LHR
“Maam humare paas amazing quality LHR machine hai — aap session le sakti ho, same results 
milenge jaise pigmentation ke mile. Baar baar waxing nahi karwani padegi.
Maine khud bhi karwaya hai — ab waxing karwani hi nahi padti.”
Coaching: Personal proof (“maine khud karwaya hai”) is your most powerful tool here — it turns a pitch into a 
recommendation from someone she trusts. Lead with the convenience (no more waxing).
4 · Advanced Under-Eye
“Maam pigmentation results ke saath aap to glow kar rahi ho bahut. Bas eye ke aas-paas ka area 
thoda dark lag raha hai — yeh bhi theek kara lete hain, aur bhi acha lagega face.
Advanced under-eye ke results bahut acche hain — maine apni family mein bhi start karwaya, unke 
bhi dark circles bahut the, ab theek hain.”
Coaching: Notice the balance — praise first, then one small, specific gap (the dark area). Family proof makes it 
personal and safe. For the clinical plan, sync with the doctor.
5 · Complete Aesthetic (full transformation)
“Maam pigmentation ke results ke saath face bahut glowing ho gaya hai. Maam skin young bhi ho 
jayegi aap ki agar hum aesthetic complete plan kar lein — poori transformation ho jayegi. Yeh 
wrinkles, loose skin, sab theek ho jayega.”
Coaching: This is the premium pitch — only for a very satisfied, high-potential client. Frame it as a complete 
transformation, not a list of procedures. The doctor co-leads the plan.
6 · Face LHR
“Maam bahut glow kar raha hai face — bas yeh thode hairs dikh rahe hain, brightness ki wajah se 
visible hain kaafi. Inn ki permanent reduction ho jayegi.
Maam sabse advanced machine hai humare paas — maine khud bhi karwaya hai LHR, mere to aap se 
zyada growth thi, ab theek ho gayi hai, dekho.”
Coaching: Again personal proof closes it. Keep it gentle and empowering — the facial-hair conversation is 
sensitive, so lead with the glow and frame it as a small finishing touch, never a flaw.
Remember
Praise the result, name one real need, offer the fix, remove pressure, lock the next step. Improvise to fit the 
client and make her feel empowered, never pressured. And stay in touch beyond balances — that relationship is 
what makes every cross-sell possible.
